name: ycbv
description: The YCB-Video (ycbv) dataset for 6DoF object pose estimation, providing RGB-D video sequences of household objects with ground-truth 6D poses. It measures object detection, segmentation, and precise 6D pose recovery under clutter and occlusion.
reputation: A widely used standard benchmark in the 6D pose estimation and robotics communities (part of the BOP suite).
